senses.gloss: ch. same, sprinkling, gurgling, jet of water.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 95a:5">Sabb. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>שרי זי׳</he> permitted sprinkling the floors on the Sabbath.

Targ. Ps. XLII, 8 ז׳ מרזביין the gurgling of gutters, v. זְלַח Ithpe.
